title: Rebase Conflict Resolution Output
description: Structured Codex output for one rebase conflict resolution attempt. Engine, mode, and round metadata are added by the persist step.

status.description: RESOLVED = the rebase advanced past all conflicts in this round. BLOCKED = conflicts cannot be safely resolved without further input or scope change. FAILED = an attempted resolution itself failed (e.g., merge introduced a compile/test error).

summary.description: One short paragraph describing what was done and why.

resolved_files.description: Paths staged with git add as part of this resolution. Empty when status is not RESOLVED.

remaining_conflicts.description: Files still in conflict state. Empty when status == RESOLVED.

commands_run.description: Shell commands executed during resolution, one per array entry.

result.description: Outcome of the verification step. Use n/a when the command does not have a pass/fail nature (e.g., status inspection).

tests_run.description: Verification commands the resolver ran after staging. Empty array when no tests ran.

notes.description: Free-form one-line notes about decisions, residual risks, or follow-up items.
